description: The Model Cycle's rule and predicate library for the symbolic bridge families (src/ml/cycle/bridges/rules.py). An atom is a test on one named raw feature column (source 'feature', resolved against the run's feature names; a name the run does not carry disables the atom with a logged line) or on one causal indicator computed from closes (source 'indicator'). A threshold is either a fixed number in the source's own units or a quantile of the TRAINING rows ('trainQuantile'), fitted per fold. 'suggests' is the direction the atom argues for, or 'none' for a filter. A rule is a conjunction of atoms with a conclusion and a certainty.

relative_strength_index.description: Wilder's relative strength index of the closes, 0..100, exponential smoothing 1/period

moving_average_convergence_divergence_hi.description: MACD line minus its signal line, divided by the causal move scale

bollinger_band_position.description: Where the close sits between the lower (0) and upper (1) band of a trailing 20-bar mean plus or minus two standard deviations

trend_slope.description: Least-squares slope of the last 20 closes per bar, divided by the causal move scale

volatility_ratio.description: Standard deviation of one-bar log returns over 10 bars divided by the same over 50 bars
